title: Page 2
content_zh:
一名侍卫肃声向内禀告：「太子殿下，原家大小姐来了。」

屋内静默了片刻，才传来低沉的声音：「请她进来。」

侍卫这才伸手为原嘉宁抬起了帘子，恭敬道：「原小姐，请进。」

锦心和锦英也想跟着进去，却被侍卫伸手拦住了。

锦心担心地唤道：「小姐？」

原嘉宁回头看了看她们俩，摇摇头，说：「我没事，你们在这等一等吧。」

原嘉宁明白，如今的太子殿下今非昔比，身分尊贵，等闲人等是不能与他同处一室的。

原嘉宁踏进屋内后，侍卫立即又放下了帘子，屋内屋外顿时隔成了两个世界。

屋内静谧无声，只有满眼惨白的颜色，堂屋正中停放着柏木棺材，棺材旁的草席上跪着一名少年。

今年刚刚十五岁的太子殿下和原嘉宁一般年纪，还只是个身形纤瘦的少年，他脸上的青涩还未完全褪去，眉眼的沉郁里也还有着少年人不会掩饰的伤痛。

玄渊穿了一身青色缎子长袍，缎子朴素无华，没有任何花纹，这大概是他能找到的最简朴的衣裳了。

身分所限，他并不能公然为生母吊孝，更不能披麻戴孝替她送葬，悄悄地来为生母祭拜，大概已经是他所能做的极限，再多就会受到玄昱的干涉了。

原嘉宁进来时，玄渊抬起头，两人的视线交会，在原嘉宁印象中那个沉稳谦和的少年不见了，她惊异地看着眼前面容冰冷，眼神冷酷，甚至带着些许受伤野兽嗜血光芒的少年，这让她的心不由得微微一颤。

皇宫果然是个扭曲人性的地方，她原来文雅端方的弟弟原琅，怎么短短两年就被扭曲成了这副模样？

但是看着玄渊被冻得隐隐发青的脸色，原嘉宁终究还是不忍地走上前，将手中的大衣披到他背上，柔声说：「殿下，夜深了，您还是回去吧。」

且不说玄渊私自出宫祭拜生母是否合乎礼仪，按照规矩，太子是不得无故外宿的。玄渊祭母的理由虽然很合理，却无法对外人公开解释，况且太子所处的东宫里有东宫官员，时刻盯着太子的一言一行，容不得他出半点差错。

玄渊却一直低着头，并没有任何回答，就在原嘉宁正想要继续劝说时，她的手忽然被人拽住，就在她的惊呼声中，她被人紧紧抱住，踉跄着跪倒在玄渊的身前，玄渊的手就那样紧紧勒住了她的后背。

「小姐？小姐？」听到她的惊呼，守在门外的锦心急忙要冲进来，却被侍卫单手就阻拦住。

「原琅。」埋在原嘉宁肩膀里的少年沉闷地说。

「什么？」原嘉宁不解。

「叫我原琅。」

「啊？」原嘉宁有点迷糊，说：「您现在是太子了，怎么还能叫您原琅呢？那样就太不敬了，也会惹麻烦的。」

「叫我原琅！」少年声音嘶哑地低诉着：「求你，宁姊姊。」

原嘉宁感受到了他无法言诉的孤独和悲伤，以及那种尴尬身分带来的压抑和绝望，她忍不住伸手摸了摸他的头，就像小时候那样，说：「大哥儿，你如今身分尊贵，不要再固执了，要想开点。」

原嘉宁原本有三个弟弟，原琅、原嘉衍、原嘉衡，她平时喜欢跟随长辈叫他们大哥儿、二哥儿、三哥儿，她喜欢这种称呼所带来的亲昵感。

只是从此以后，再也没有她印象里的「大哥儿」了吧？

「叫我原琅。」太子殿下依然固执地要求着。

原嘉宁无奈地笑笑，他从小就这样，虽然外表文雅，像个小大人，但自己认定的事就绝对不会改变，固执得让人头疼呢。

「原琅。」她轻轻地喊他。

第1章(2)

玄渊抱紧原嘉宁的手顿了一下，随即他又抱得更紧，好像溺水的人抱住最后一根可以救命的浮木，再也不想放手，也无法放手。

她是他此刻唯一的救赎，如果放开她，那种残忍、冷酷的绝望感大概会彻底毁了他吧？

没有人知道此时出现的原嘉宁对于玄渊意味着什么。

在他刚刚被立为太子，在他被众人的恭贺喧闹围绕时，就算他再沉稳谦和，十五岁的少年也不免被恭维得有点飘飘然，然而就在此时他却突然收到了生母去世的消息，这消息宛如晴天霹雳，狠狠打破了他的虚荣美梦，他从云霄跌入了地狱，他瞬间明白了生母为何会突然死去──这是他成为太子的代价！

如果被世人知道了太子的生母是大臣的小妾，是皇帝和大臣的小妾私通下的私生子，那太子的地位还能保住吗？别说保了，太子能不能立都是个问题。

玄昱不会容许自己所立的太子有个身分尴尬的生母，更不能让他的出身成为丑闻，所以，叶姨娘必须死。

如果玄渊只是一位普通皇子，或许玄昱还会容许叶姨娘苟活着，但是一旦确立玄渊做了自己的继承人，那么叶姨娘就再没有任何活路了。

这一点，原修之也看得很清楚，所以他没有出手阻拦。

只要玄昱立玄渊做了太子，那么处死叶姨娘就是必须要做的事，否则国之储君地位不稳，后患更多。

玄渊跪在叶姨娘的灵柩前，比任何时候都更清楚地明白了何谓「皇家无亲情」。

天寒地冻，他的心却更冷。

他前所未有地迷惘了。

他的前途，就是这已注定好的无情帝王路吗？他成为太子的第一步，就是以生母之命换来的，那他日后要正式登基做皇帝，还需要多少的鲜血和人命来献祭？

就在他陷入自己诡谲残酷的思绪中时，原嘉宁突然来了，带着她一如往常的温柔体贴，那是比他的生母更让他依恋耽溺的温柔啊。

只比他大了半个月，却从小就爱以大姊姊身分自居的少女，自小就带给了他太多的温暖和美好，如果说原府只有一样东西令他不舍的，也就是原嘉宁了吧？

十五岁的少年，正站在人生最危险的岔路口，再往前走，或许一步天堂，也许一步地狱。少年人情感冲动大于理智，如果不是原嘉宁的到来，唤醒了他的理智，或许阴森的执念就会从此深驻他的心底，等待有一天毁灭了他。

而此刻他怀抱着原嘉宁，感受少女独特的柔软和芳香，他那冰冷扭曲的心，总算又有了一丝丝属于人间的温度。

屋里再次静默下来，只有外面的风声呼啸而过。

「叫我原琅，」良久之后，他才喃喃地说：「我愿意永远做你的弟弟。」

此刻他是太子，日后他会是皇帝，他的心里却只有原嘉宁是自己唯一的亲人，他要以弟弟的身分保护她一辈子，不允许她被任何人欺负，庇护她一生平安喜乐。

三日后。

原嘉宁正坐在花窗下的美人榻上做针线活，榻下燃着两个火盆，让屋里暖融融的。

外面已经不下雪了，但是正值化雪之时，天气更冷，人们通常不会外出，都躲在屋子里。

原嘉宁在为原琅缝制素白的棉布内衫，这是那夜原琅要求的，他不能公然为生母守孝，便想将孝衣穿在里面。幸好原嘉宁自从学习做女红后，就开始为自己的弟弟妹妹们做衣裳，做这种简单的针线活，难不倒她。

她能明白原琅不愿宫中尚衣局的人为他做内衫的理由，毕竟他的隐私越少人知道越好。

但是，原嘉宁多少还是有点困扰，再怎么说，如今的原琅已不是她的弟弟，他叫玄渊了，是一人之下万人之上的尊贵太子殿下，她为他做内衫，真的不会有问题吗？
content_en:
A guard reported in a solemn voice: "Your Highness, the eldest lady of the Yuan family is here."

There was silence in the room for a moment before a low voice came: "Please come in."

The guard then stretched out his hand to lift the curtain for Yuan Jianing and said respectfully: "Miss Yuan, please come in."

Jin Xin and Jin Ying also wanted to follow in, but were stopped by the guards with their hands.

Jin Xin called out worriedly: "Miss?"

Yuan Jianing looked back at the two of them, shook his head and said, "I'm fine, just wait here."

Yuan Jianing understood that His Highness the Crown Prince was no longer what he used to be. He had a distinguished status and no one else could be in the same room with him.

After Yuan Jianing stepped into the house, the guard immediately lowered the curtain, and the inside and outside of the house were suddenly separated into two worlds.

The room was silent, except for the pale color. There was a cypress coffin parked in the middle of the hall, and a young man was kneeling on the straw mat next to the coffin.

His Royal Highness, who is just fifteen years old this year, is about the same age as Yuan Jianing. He is still a slender boy. The youthfulness on his face has not completely faded away, and there is still pain in the gloominess of his eyebrows that young people cannot hide.

Xuan Yuan wore a blue satin robe. The satin was plain and without any patterns. This was probably the simplest clothes he could find.

Due to his status, he could not publicly pay homage to his biological mother, let alone mourn her at the funeral. Secretly coming to worship his biological mother was probably the limit of what he could do. No matter how much he did, he would be interfered by Xuan Yu.

When Yuan Jianing came in, Xuan Yuan raised his head, and their eyes met. The calm and humble young man in Yuan Jianing's impression was gone. She was surprised to see the young man in front of her with a cold face, cold eyes, and even a bloodthirsty light of a wounded beast. This made her heart tremble slightly.

The palace is indeed a place where human nature is twisted. How could her originally elegant and upright brother Yuan Lang be twisted into this state in just two years?

But looking at Xuan Yuan's face that was slightly blue from the cold, Yuan Jianing finally couldn't bear to step forward, put the coat in his hands on his back, and said softly: "Your Highness, it's late at night, you'd better go back."

Not to mention whether it was etiquette for Xuan Yuan to go out of the palace privately to worship his biological mother. According to the rules, the prince was not allowed to stay outside without any reason.Although Xuan Yuan's reason for sacrificing his mother was very reasonable, it could not be explained publicly to outsiders. Moreover, there were officials from the East Palace where the prince lived. They were always watching the prince's words and deeds and could not tolerate any mistakes from him.

However, Xuan Yuan kept his head lowered and did not reply. Just when Yuan Jianing was about to continue persuading, her hand was suddenly grabbed by someone. In her exclamation, she was hugged tightly and staggered to kneel in front of Xuan Yuan. Xuan Yuan's hand tightly strangled her back.

"Miss? Miss?" Hearing her exclamation, Jin Xin, who was guarding the door, hurriedly rushed in, but was stopped by the guard with one hand.

"Yuan Lang." The young man buried in Yuan Jianing's shoulder said dullly.

"What?" Yuan Jianing was puzzled.

"Call me Yuan Lang."

"Ah?" Yuan Jianing was a little confused and said, "You are the prince now, how can I still call you Yuan Lang? That would be too disrespectful and would cause trouble."

"Call me Yuan Lang!" The young man whispered hoarsely: "Please, Sister Ning."

Yuan Jianing felt his unspeakable loneliness and sadness, as well as the depression and despair brought about by that embarrassing status. She couldn't help but reached out and touched his head, just like she did when she was a child, and said, "Brother, you are now of noble status. Stop being stubborn and be more open-minded."

Yuan Jianing originally had three younger brothers, Yuan Lang, Yuan Jiayan, and Yuan Jiaheng. She usually liked to follow her elders and call them eldest brother, second brother, and third brother. She liked the sense of intimacy brought by this title.

It's just that from now on, there will no longer be a "big brother" in her impression, right?

"Call me Yuan Lang." His Highness the Crown Prince still stubbornly requested.

Yuan Jianing smiled helplessly. He had been like this since he was a child. Although he looked elegant and looked like a little adult, he would never change what he believed in. He was so stubborn that it gave people a headache.

"Yuan Lang." She called him softly.

Chapter 1(2)

Xuan Yuan hugged Yuan Jianing's hand tightly for a moment, and then he hugged him even tighter, like a drowning man hugging the last piece of driftwood that can save his life, never wanting to let go, and unable to let go.

She is his only salvation at the moment. If he lets her go, that cruel and cold despair will probably completely destroy him, right?

No one knows what Yuan Jianing's appearance at this time means to Xuan Yuan.

When he had just been made a prince, and when he was surrounded by the noise of congratulations, no matter how calm and humble he was, the fifteen-year-old boy could not help but feel a little carried away by the compliments. However, at this moment, he suddenly received the news that his biological mother had passed away. This news was like a bolt from the blue, shattering his dream of vanity. He fell from the sky into hell. He instantly understood why his biological mother died suddenly - this was the price for his becoming the prince!

If the world knew that the prince's biological mother was the minister's concubine, and that he was the illegitimate son of the emperor and the minister's concubine, could the prince's status be preserved?Not to mention the guarantee, whether the crown prince can be established is still a question.

Xuan Yu would not allow the prince he appointed to have an embarrassing biological mother, let alone let his parentage become a scandal, so Aunt Ye must die.

If Xuan Yuan was just an ordinary prince, perhaps Xuan Yu would have allowed Aunt Ye to survive, but once it was established that Xuan Yuan was his heir, then Aunt Ye would have no way to survive.

Yuan Xiuzhi also saw this very clearly, so he did not stop it.

As long as Xuan Yu establishes Xuanyuan as the crown prince, then executing Aunt Ye must be done. Otherwise, the status of the crown prince will be unstable and there will be more troubles in the future.

Xuan Yuan knelt in front of Aunt Ye's coffin and understood more clearly than ever what "no family affection in the royal family" meant.

It was freezing cold, but his heart was even colder.

He was more confused than ever.

Is his future destined to be the path of a ruthless emperor?His first step to becoming a prince was in exchange for his biological mother's life. So if he were to formally ascend the throne as emperor in the future, how much more blood and lives would he need to sacrifice?

Just when he was immersed in his strange and cruel thoughts, Yuan Jianing suddenly came, with her usual tenderness and considerateness, which was a tenderness that made him more attached and indulgent than his biological mother.

The girl who was only half a month older than him, but who had loved to consider herself an elder sister since she was a child, had brought him so much warmth and beauty since he was a child. If there was only one thing in Yuan Mansion that he couldn't let go of, it was Yuan Jianing, right?

The fifteen-year-old boy is standing at the most dangerous fork in the road in his life. If he goes forward, he may go to heaven or to hell.The young man's emotional impulse is greater than his reason. If Yuan Jianing's arrival had not awakened his reason, perhaps the dark obsession would have stayed deep in his heart from then on, waiting to destroy him one day.

But at this moment, he was holding Yuan Jianing in his arms, feeling the girl's unique softness and fragrance. His cold and twisted heart finally had a trace of human warmth.

The room fell silent again, except for the howling wind outside.

"Call me Yuan Lang," he murmured after a long time, "I am willing to be your brother forever."

He is the prince now, and he will be the emperor in the future, but in his heart, only Yuan Jianing is his only relative. He will protect her as a younger brother for the rest of his life, not allowing her to be bullied by anyone, and protecting her peace and happiness throughout her life.

Three days later.

Yuan Jianing was sitting on the beauty couch under the flower window doing needlework. Two braziers were burning under the couch, making the room warm.

It's no longer snowing outside, but when the snow melts, the weather is even colder. People usually don't go out and hide in their houses.

Yuan Jianing was sewing a plain white cotton undershirt for Yuan Lang. This was Yuan Lang's request that night. He couldn't openly observe filial piety for his biological mother, so he wanted to wear the filial piety clothes inside.Fortunately, Yuan Jianing has started making clothes for her younger brothers and sisters since she learned to be a female celebrity. Such simple needlework is not difficult for her.

She could understand why Yuan Lang didn't want people from the Palace Clothing Bureau to make underwear for him. After all, the less people knew about his privacy, the better.

However, Yuan Jianing is still a little troubled. After all, Yuan Lang is no longer her brother. His name is Xuan Yuan, and he is the noble prince who is inferior to one person and superior to ten thousand people. Is it really not a problem for her to make underwear for him?
